morning.caption:
Chip stocks slumped across Asia on Wednesday. Korea's KOSPI fell 6.2%, Taiwan's Taiex 5% and Japan's Nikkei 2.8%, with Samsung down 9.9% and SK Hynix 11.1%, after a 7.9% drop in US chip stocks on doubts about AI spending. India's Sensex rose 2.4%.

Watch US PCE inflation at 8:30 a.m. ET. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

midday.caption:
Sanofi agreed to buy Insmed for $175 a share in cash, about $41 billion. The deal adds Brinsupri, a once daily lung disease pill that Sanofi says earned $1.09 billion through September. It is expected to close in the first half of 2027 and is funded with debt and cash. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

evening.caption:
The US is expected to soon announce higher tariffs on China, the EU and 14 other economies after Section 301 investigations into industrial subsidies, two people familiar with the plan told AP. Rates and timing are not yet clear, and the White House did not comment. Watch for USTR's findings this week. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com
